APSRTC
CAUTION NOTICE
Notice is hereby given that APSRTC (ANDHRA PRADESH STATE ROAD TRANSPORT
CORPORATION), an Indian corporation having its Corporate office at Bus Bhavan, Musheerabad,
Hyderabad - 500020, A.P. state, are the registered proprietors of the trademark "APSRTC®" with
no. 2324236 and 2324237 for “Transport, Booking of seats for Travel, Transport, Transportation
Information, Travel Reservations, Transport Brokerage, Arrange of tours, Tourism,
Passengers Transport, Travel Arrangements, Travel Information, Rental of car, Rental of
Vehicle, Logistic; Advertising, Marketing, Online Advertising, Compilation of computer
Information into computer Data bases, Systemization of Information into computer Data
bases, Data search in computer files for others, Computerized file Management, Layout
services for Advertising purpose, publicity” under class 39 and 35 of the Trade mark rules
respectively.
Over the years, the mark "APSRTC®" has built immense reputation in Road Transportation
in A.P. based on the quality and reliability of it’s services. Unscrupulous persons have been
fraudulently “Cyber squatting” the domain names of their Websites with the "APSRTC®" name and
brand. The public are cautioned against such spurious Websites and such persons.
The use of the name “APSRTC” or any other words containing the combination of word
“APSRTC” as a Trade mark or Trade name or Trading style by any person or Firm in relation to the
aforesaid services or any other like services would amount to infringement of our Trade mark and
passing off their Business.
Such persons or Firms are hereby warned of stringent legal action for "passing off" under the
Trade Marks Act, 1999, and also for "passing off", involving cheating and fraud, among others, under
Indian Penal Code, 1860. In the interests of the public as well as fair trade practice, Firms or public at
large are cautioned and advised to desist from such practices. Further, such persons or Firms are
hereby cautioned to cease and desist forthwith from using the said word as a Trade Mark or Trading
style.
Any person affected by the "passing off" of spurious services under "APSRTC®" trademark
may file a complaint with the nearest police station. They may also inform APSRTC in Hyderabad at
the following address
The COS (Senior Manager – IT),
APSRTC, Bus Bhavan,
Musheerabad,
Hyderabad – 500020
Mail id: cossmit@apsrtc.gov.in
